finding.title: Introduce test/helpers/pump_app.dart — 6 gamification test files hand-roll near-identical MaterialApp/ProviderScope boilerplate
finding.why: docs/coding-standards.md:462-465 (TQ-3) names `test/helpers/pump_app.dart` as 'the reviewed convention' for this exact ProviderScope+localization-delegate boilerplate, but the file doesn't exist anywhere in the repo (confirmed via ls test/helpers/). In this batch alone, child_redemption_screen_l1_test.dart (_pumpScreen + _pumpScreenWithRouter), gamification_screen_l1_test.dart (_buildApp), parent_pending_redemptions_screen_l1_test.dart (_buildScreen + buildWithRouter), reward_configuration_screen_l1_test.dart (_buildFake), streak_widget_test.dart (buildWidget) and achievement_unlock_celebration_test.dart (_buildHarness) each reimplement the same ~20-30 line scaffold independently; achievement_unlock_celebration_test.dart even duplicates its own _buildHarness body inline twice (lines 272-294 and 297-319) instead of calling it, showing the drift risk in practice — any future fix to the shared scaffold (e.g. a new required delegate) must be hand-applied at every site.
finding.recommendation: Create test/helpers/pump_app.dart per the standards doc and migrate these builders to call it, parameterizing only the feature-specific overrides.
acceptance_criteria: The 6 cited builder functions delegate to it instead of duplicating MaterialApp/localizationsDelegates/ProviderScope setup.

finding.title: Update docs/delete-policy.md — curriculum_tracks moved from deletedAt to state/stateChangedAt in W3.28/W3.29
finding.rule: AG-8 (schema diffs update their paired doc in the same PR) / Tier-4 canonical-doc factual drift

evidence.quote: replaced ad-hoc `isActive`/`deletedAt`/`deactivatedAt` tombstone columns with a single unified `state` enum column

finding.why: curriculum_tracks has no `deletedAt` column at all today — it was replaced by `state`/`stateChangedAt`. A reader implementing new delete-policy-adjacent code from this doc would query/write a column that doesn't exist. The same doc's coverage table also never mentions daily_plans/point_configs/profile_programs/study_day_configs/outbox/curriculum_scopes/prior_completion_imports, all of which track_dao.dart and profile_repository_impl.dart delete explicitly.
finding.recommendation: Update the table row to 'state = deleted + stateChangedAt'; consider adding rows for the other tables track_dao.dart/profile_repository_impl.dart already delete explicitly so the doc is a complete map of delete behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Doc's column-name claim matches an actual column in the current schema (grep-checkable).

finding.title: Consolidate test/sync/'s merger and round-trip tests into the AG-5-mirrored test/core/sync/ location — they duplicate existing coverage

evidence.quote: /// Round-trip test: the canonical write serializer (LearningLedgerCodec.encode)
/// Round-trip test: the canonical write serializer (StreakEventCodec.encode)
/// Round-trip test: the canonical write serializer (TrackCodec.encode) must
/// Round-trip test: the canonical write serializer (LearnerProfileCodec.encode)

/// Unit tests for the LWW merge implementations:
/// [TrackConfigMerger], [SettingsMerger], [LearnerProfileMerger].
/// Round-trip test: the canonical write serializer (StageDefinitionCodec.encode)
/// Regression tests for sacred-time / location scope in the UI-preferences

///   - [StageDefinitionCodec] encode↔decode round-trips (all schedule branches,
///   - [UiPreferencesMerger] LWW gate, per-field writes, cross-profile isolation,
/// Phase 3 LWW symmetry tests for every LWW merger.
/// Phase 3: assert every LWW merger persists the remote `updated_at` via

finding.why: All 24 files in this batch live under test/sync/, not the AG-5-mandated mirror of lib/core/sync/ (test/core/sync/), which already exists and is independently populated (12 files). For at least 9 of this batch's files the overlap is not just structural placement — it is the same merger/scenario tested twice: LearningLedgerMerger's snake_case-shape regression ('C1 regression' in learning_ledger_merger_test.dart) is retested by learning_ledger_roundtrip_test.dart's codec round-trip; StreakEventMerger's study_date-shape regression ('C2 regression') is retested by streak_events_roundtrip_test.dart; TrackConfigMerger/SettingsMerger/LearnerProfileMerger's LWW behavior (mergers_test.dart, against a hand-rolled fake MergeStore) is retested by curriculum_tracks_roundtrip_test.dart/learner_profile_roundtrip_test.dart/lww_symmetric_test.dart/persist_updated_at_test.dart (against the real DriftMergeStore); StageDefinitionMerger's schedule-shape and UiPreferencesMerger's 'no sacred_time clobber' behavior (codecs_and_mergers_test.dart, 1298 lines) is retested by stage_definitions_roundtrip_test.dart, location_device_scope_test.dart, and sacred_time_all_profiles_test.dart. docs/test-options.md documents test/sync/** as THE location for this coverage and never mentions test/core/sync/ existing — this is undocumented drift, not a deliberate two-tier split (both directories tag tests 'unit'). Every schema/key-name change to these ~9 mergers now needs edits in two independently-evolving files to stay correct, and a change is more likely to update one and silently leave the other testing stale behavior. This also explains a large slice of the orchestrator's own global ag5-unmirrored.txt pre-scan, which lists nearly all of lib/core/sync/merge/*.dart and lib/core/sync/codec/*.dart as having no exact-path test.
finding.recommendation: Pick test/core/sync/ as canonical (per AG-5's own 1:1 rule). For each duplicate pair, fold any scenario unique to the era-1 file (e.g. mergers_test.dart's fake-MergeStore isolation, if it adds value beyond the real-store versions) into the era-2 roundtrip test, then delete the superseded file. Update docs/test-options.md's test/sync/** references to match wherever coverage ends up.
acceptance_criteria: an AG-5 unmirrored-test audit shows zero lib/core/sync/merge/*.dart or lib/core/sync/codec/*.dart entries once consolidation lands

the consolidated LearningLedgerMerger/StreakEventMerger/TrackConfigMerger/SettingsMerger/LearnerProfileMerger/StageDefinitionMerger/UiPreferencesMerger suites keep every distinct scenario from both current suites while removing exact duplicates (test count is not simply additive)

finding.title: Stop interpolating e.toString() directly into tutoring error/snackbar text
finding.why: manage_grants_screen.dart and manage_tutors_screen.dart interpolate a raw Dart exception's toString() into an otherwise-localized ARB string 4 times, so a Hebrew UI sentence ends with an untranslated English/technical fragment (e.g. a gRPC status string). The 6 matching data-layer sites (firestore_tutor_grant_repository.dart x6, tutor_write_service.dart x1) manufacture that raw string in the first place by stuffing `e.toString()` into the Failure.message field instead of a stable code, which is exactly the custom_lint `no_e_to_string_in_ui` rule this repo already has defined (currently non-enforcing because custom_lint is broken repo-wide).
finding.recommendation: In the 4 UI catch blocks, map to a generic localized fallback (as invite_tutor_screen.dart already does for TutorGrantFailure) instead of interpolating e.toString(); in the data layer, log e.toString() via AppLogger and return a stable failure code instead of stashing the raw text in the value the UI eventually reads.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn 'e.toString()' lib/features/tutoring/presentation/ returns no UI-text interpolation sites.
Widget test confirms a thrown exception during revoke/rescind/load shows a fixed localized string regardless of the exception's message.
